newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PLAYBOY EPS VIEW CUT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PLAYBOY EPS VIEW CUT.

text.p: Gruntal & Co analyst Rita Zanella Benson said Wednesday she lowered her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Playboy Enterprises Inc to $0.52 a share from $0.54.

-- "However, we continue to find (Playboy) the least expensive stock in our group...and we continue to recommend purchase with a price target of $24," she said in a report. She rates Playboy a "strong buy."
-- On Tuesday, Playboy reported fiscal fourth quarter earnings of $0.08 a share, up from $0.07 and in line with expectations.
-- The earnings estimate for fiscal 1998 was trimmed due to softness in catalogs, which were weak in the fourth quarter with revenue off six percent, the analyst said.

-- "During the quarter, revenue increased one percent to $77 million while operating income was flat," the analyst said. "The majority of the company's businesses performed slightly lower than expectations, with Playboy Television and magazine being the bright spots in the quarter. With mixed results among its businesses, the stock traded off slightly."
